name: 27332 · Sanford, NC
findings: ZIP 27332 (Sanford) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 17 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27332 (Sanford) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27332 (Sanford) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 50% of the typical level).
